description: 藍色公路海況預報-藍色公路臺北港平潭航線 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 交通部中央氣象署. 每6小時提供藍色公路臺北港平潭航線預報海況資訊 如需大量下載資料者請至氣象資料開放平臺申請會員 cwa. gov. tw/index. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 交通部中央氣象署. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-12-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
